value.rationale: Diagonal coordinate permutations on two factors of a polyhedral product are a natural alternative to independent factor rotations, introducing finite stabilizers. The result supplies a complete, torsion-free integral cohomology ring and shows primitive, nontrivial cross products of rank r_n^2 together with exponentially many additional H^2 classes; these structural features cannot be read from Euler characteristics or rational invariant dimensions. It is a uniform mathematically motivated classification, not an isolated small-n calculation.
